title: Youth Take Over
speaker: Jed Hartnett, Micaela Embellado, Phoebe Baker
blurb:
Three young people stood up on a Sunday morning and said things that were clearly not rehearsed into smoothness. That's part of what makes this worth watching.

Jed, Micaela and Phoebe each brought something different: a moment of hearing something from God without knowing what it was, a vision at youth camp that changed the question from "does God care about my problems?" to "why am I so hesitant to give him everything?", and a year of waiting on a call that felt increasingly uncertain, until a stranger at a conference prayed something over Phoebe that she couldn't have staged.

The thread running through all three is the same: the quiet place. Not a technique. Not a retreat. A daily choice to stop, listen, and trust the one who is speaking even when you can't see where it leads.

There's also a moment involving Catholic school boys, a midday mantra and the word "beef" that probably shouldn't be as funny as it is.

If you've been carrying something loud lately, this one might be worth your time.
